description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called CalculatorView for a calculator interface, along with its associated view model CalculatorCardViewModel. It handles user input, performs basic arithmetic operations, and displays results.

classes.name: CalculatorCardViewModel
classes.description: A view model managing calculator state, input parsing, and arithmetic operations with published properties for input and result.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds the parsed input value to the current result.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Subtracts the parsed input value from the current result.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Multiplies the current result by the parsed input value.

methods.name: divide
methods.description: Divides the current result by the parsed input value, handling division by zero.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets input and result to initial state.

methods.name: parseInput
methods.description: Converts input string into a Double, accepting both comma and dot as decimal separators.
